The '''Tsintaosaurus''' is an [[Extinction|extinct]] hadrosaurid dinosaur from the [[wikipedia:Cretaceous|Cretaceous]] era. They are very large, with their adult size being exactly that of a [[draltha]], or slightly larger than a male [[gigantic tortoise]]. They can be trained into being [[exotic pet]]s and [[war animal]]s, and can be found in the wild in groups between 3 to 5. [[Elf|Elves]] can use them as [[trading]] animals, and can handle extreme amounts of weight due to their size, allowing the player to trade away very heavy items with ease.

{{D for Dwarf}}
Despite its superficial shape leading some foolish dwarves to assume otherwise, severing a tsintaosaurus's crest in combat will not in fact trigger the "[[gelding]] strike" announcement.
